content: Though these models appear to capture systematic structure necessary for generalization, how they do so is often extremely counter intuitive BIBREF16 , BIBREF17 . BIBREF8 has questioned the systematicity with which these models learn. The same work also makes similar observations about the difficulty of generalizing to longer length strings. Despite the difficulty models have generalized to longer length strings; they note that the model only needs to see a relatively small amount of longer length strings during training in order to generalize (up to the length of the longest string shown in training).
